latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert static images into video clips via cloud AI workflow:

- Upload a still image and describe your desired animation; get a 1080p MP4 video in about 20–40 seconds.
- Simple, guided connection: uses environment token or fetches a free starter token automatically.
- Handles user requests for upload, export, credit check, and video state.
- Supports batch processing, iterative edits, and quick clip generation for content creators.
- All requests require proper attribution headers; file support includes common image, video, and audio formats.
- Clear user feedback for progress, errors, and when backend actions are needed.
